segments.label: Nevada tribal gaming cross-check
rules: Cross-check NIGC current gaming locations and Nevada tribal/operator sources before finalizing Pass 22.
Do not assume NGCB nonrestricted roster fully represents tribal Class II or compact gaming destinations.
Apply the same physical-destination, current-operation, alias and coordinate standards used in Oregon and Washington.

notes: This ledger intentionally favors undercounting over inventing rural casino destinations. Additional active NGCB nonrestricted properties can be added during statewide roster reconciliation.
